verdict.rationale: gstack is a skills pack that AI coding agents drive through slash-command skills and a router skill (docs-18). It also ships a compiled CLI (`$B`) fronting a persistent headless Chromium daemon (docs-14, docs-25). These are agent-drivable interfaces, but nothing in the evidence describes a documented public API such as HTTP endpoints, an SDK or an API reference. The probes show no product-specific machine-readable docs: the llms.txt hit belongs to GitHub, and gstack.md returned 404. Missing for 10: a documented public API surface (endpoints/SDK/reference docs), API stability or versioning guarantees, independent evidence of programmatic use outside skill invocation.
